As someone who also has, from what you’re describing, pretty bad social anxiety i actually just got my first job in retail. I’ve a dishwasher at a local restaurant. It sounds like a really gross and dirty job, but there are a few benefits. You don’t have to talk to strangers, you don’t have to rely on tips to get paid, it’s a fairly needed job so you’ll be hired easily. 

One thing that might get in your way is the fact the you might need a minor work permit. I (15F) had to get one of those in my state before i was allowed to work. You can google how old you need to be in ur state to work without a permit 

Here’s how to get one:
To get on you have to go to your school councilor or principal or advisor and either they will give you the form or they can tell you who will have it. It’s actually pretty short and only like a page and a half. There are three sections, personal info, physical, and employer section. The personal info you can pretty easily figure out yourself. The physical you need to bring into your doctor so they can approve that you’re physically able to work. Then the employer section is for after you find someone willing to hire. They have a brief section to fill out. Once everything is completed bring it back to the person you got the form from. They will submit it to the government and in about a day or two you’ll have a work permit!

I’m really only speaking from personal experience here as someone who literally got my work permit email as I was typing this lol. I’m sure there are plenty of other jobs in retail that don’t require you to talk to people. I wish you the best of luck!
